title: Check Recent Tasks & Cron Jobs for Errors
description: Opens a terminal and asks OpenClaw to review your last 5 tasks and last 5 cron job runs for anything abnormal - errors, timeouts, malformed result files, a task stuck at "running" with no recent activity - and report back what it actually finds, with the specific file and timestamp for each issue. If nothing's wrong, it'll say so rather than inventing something to report.
